title: "Albums"

---

Explore the album collection below. You can search, sort by release date or track count, and browse interactively:

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

albums <- read_csv("data/bruce/albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    releaseDate = as.Date(releaseDate),
    Cover = paste0('<img src="', artworkUrl100, '" width="60">')
  ) |>
  select(Cover, Title = collectionName, `Release Date` = releaseDate, Tracks = trackCount, Genre = primaryGenreName)

datatable(albums, escape = FALSE, options = list(pageLength = 6, autoWidth = TRUE))
```
